none: PAS NLM-1D86D6: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Bonby
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above with a frond between the stars. In exergue: TRS, for second officina, Trier mint. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.58gms, die axis: 6
